description: Eli Lilly announced topline SURMOUNT-1 (Phase 3) results: tirzepatide achieved up to 22.5% weight loss at 72 weeks vs placebo in adults with obesity/overweight without diabetes, meeting co-primary endpoints.

source.verified: Lilly investor press release + PRNewswire, verified 2026-09-13

knowable_time_source: Lilly topline press release 2022-04-28 (the disclosure). Verified 2026-09-13.
note_on_stamps: A topline announcement: the reported result and its disclosure coincide (event_time == knowable_time).

outcome.note: Met co-primary endpoints (up to 22.5% weight loss). The trial result, not a claim about the stock reaction.

disclosure_timing_source: Lilly SURMOUNT-1 topline press release 2022-04-28, released pre-market (Lilly convention for material topline data; date verified, exact time not timestamp-checked).
